caption:
Oracle's roughly 12,000 India cuts. Reductions at Amazon, TCS, Accenture, Flipkart. Trackers put global tech job losses past 90,000 in the first four months of this year. That is the room you are walking into for the next all-hands.

Here is what nobody is coaching: how you sit in that chair.

When the skip-level turns into "justify your function," volume will not save you. Three things will.

Bearing. Feet planted, hands still, spine carrying its own weight. A body that fidgets tells the room the decision has already gone against you.

Tone. Drop the pitch. End sentences on a full stop, not a rise. You are reporting, not requesting.

Calculated silence. Take two full seconds before you answer. Let the question sit. The person who rushes to fill quiet is the person who is worried.

In 35 years of command, Colonel Suhag watched briefings decided before the first slide. Bearing goes in first. Make yours arrive ahead of you.
